task_title: Reclaim stale CLI completion locks and make tier-1 test gates honest
task_criteria: Land two commits on origin/main: (1) bin/speclang's recordCliCompletion() must record its owner PID and reclaim a lock whose recorded PID is dead, never removing a lock whose owner is alive, and tests/cli/completion.test.ts must cover a dead-PID lock, an unreadable lock past the staleness window, and a live owner; (2) .gitreins/config.yaml's tier1 tests step and guards.test_command must both propagate vitest's exit status instead of tail's or grep's, red-proofed by a deliberately failing test. Evidence: full suite green (2122 tests, 0 failed) after the fix, versus 20 failures and 601s before, and gitreins config-validate with only the pre-existing unknown-key warnings.

items.criterion: Land two commits on origin/main: (1) bin/speclang's recordCliCompletion() must record its owner PID and reclaim a lock whose recorded PID is dead, never removing a lock whose owner is alive, and tests/cli/completion.test.ts must cover a dead-PID lock, an unreadable lock past the staleness window, and a live owner; (2) .gitreins/config.yaml's tier1 tests step and guards.test_command must both propagate vitest's exit status instead of tail's or grep's, red-proofed by a deliberately failing test. Evidence: full suite green (2122 tests, 0 failed) after the fix, versus 20 failures and 601s before, and gitreins config-validate with only the pre-existing unknown-key warnings.
items.detail: Both commits on origin/main (git branch -r --contains: 2ecc2d2d 'fix: reclaim stale CLI completion locks' and ae7baab2 'gate: make both tier-1 test arms report the suite's real status'). (1) bin/speclang: lock owner PID written at acquisition (`fs.writeSync(fd, `${process.pid}`)`, ~line 66); lockOwnerState() lines 27-50 returns 'stale' only for ESRCH dead PID or age>LOCK_STALE_MS (5 min) when no usable PID, 'contended' for live PID/EPERM/own PID — reclaim at lines 80-87 bounded by MAX_LOCK_RECLAIMS=8, live owner never unlinked. tests/cli/completion.test.ts covers dead-PID lock (line 159, reclaims in <5s), unreadable lock past staleness window (line 176, empty body + mtime 10min old), live owner never stolen (line 191, spawns live holder, asserts lock content unchanged and waiter still blocked). Targeted run: `npx vitest run tests/cli/completion.test.ts` → 'Tests 20 passed (20)', exit 0. (2) .gitreins/config.yaml line 9 test_command is now bare `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` (vitest's own exit status); tier1 tests step lines 84-86 capture `rc=$?` and `exit $rc` while keeping tail -20 for triage. Red-proof executed by me: deliberately failing test through the step's exact shell shape → 'Tests  1 failed (1)', STEP_RC=1. Full suite run by me: `npx vitest run --passWithNoTests` → 'Test Files 126 passed | 4 skipped (130)', 'Tests 2064 passed | 58 skipped (2122)', EXIT_CODE=0 — 2122 total, 0 failed as claimed. `gitreins config-validate` → only 6 unknown-key warnings (assemble, assemble_command, build, build_command, provider, api_key_env), all keys present in the parent commit's config, i.e. pre-existing. [resolution 0.00; tests/cli/completion.test.ts]

items.criterion: Reachability — recordCliCompletion (with the new reclaim logic) must be reachable from the CLI entrypoint for the lanes it records.
items.detail: bin/speclang:128-138 installs a process.once('exit') hook for lanes validate/cascade/generate/index/guard that calls recordCliCompletion(completionRoot, completionLane, exitCode, durationMs) at line 135, so the new lock-reclaim path (lines 80-87) runs on every CLI exit in those lanes; the new tests exercise it end-to-end by spawning the real bin/speclang binary.
